notes.title: Castle of Secrets Update #2
notes.content:
Hello Curse Breakers,

We have prepared another patch to address bugs, increase character movement speed, improve cutscenes, and also add a new hidden location!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41822167/510697784590f28d28caac3b68de156b153a7d0f.png
Patch Notes

 Find the secret passage to the hidden location of the ruined city through the Hell level and unlock an achievement.
 A new scene with two wooden monsters has been added to the Graveyard location.
 Bug fixes.
 Increased character movement speed.
 Quest titles no longer overflow the task frame.
 Added sounds to cutscenes for better immersion.
 Hints on the F key are now always visible, even from a distance.
 Fixed some achievement issues.
 Added music to the skeleton disco — now they dance to the beat!

notes.title: Castle of Secrets Update #1
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has checked out the game since launch! We are keeping an eye on feedback and have put together an update to address some initial issues:

Patch Highlights
 Fixed various bugs
 Added particle effects to hard-to-find items
 Improved localization
 Increased the number of interactive objects
 Removed unnecessary objects from scenes that were getting in the way
 Added a new cutscene for the tree monster
 Adjusted sound volumes to prevent sudden loud noises

notes.title: Release Date Update for Castle of Secrets
notes.content:
Dear Castle of Secrets Community, 

First and foremost, we want to say we’re truly sorry. We know many of you have been eagerly awaiting the release of Castle of Secrets, and it means the world to us that you’ve been on this journey with us.

After a lot of careful thought, we’ve made the difficult decision to postpone the game’s launch. We understand this may be disappointing, and we share in that feeling — this isn’t the message we hoped to be sending.

That said, we believe taking this extra time is the right choice. It will allow us to further refine the experience, address remaining issues, and make sure that when you finally set foot inside the castle, it’s everything it’s meant to be — a world rich with mystery, atmosphere, and depth.

We’ll be announcing the new release date soon, and we promise it won’t be a long wait. Thank you so much for your patience, your understanding, and your belief in what we’re building.

With gratitude and respect,
The Castle of Secrets Team

Though the castle doors remain closed a little longer, the halls of our Discord are open — join our community to get real-time updates on the release date and upcoming events.

notes.title: Official Statement from the Developers of Castle of Secrets
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41822167/52ab8338933b6f15da6bd8f0eef7c476b2f1bd87.png
Official Statement from the Developers of Castle of Secrets
We’d like to address some recent confusion regarding the voice acting in Castle of Secrets.
To set the record straight: the full game features professional English voice acting, performed by real voice actors. These talented individuals have contributed significantly to bringing the world of Castle of Secrets to life, and we will be properly crediting them for their work.
To clarify, the use of AI voice technology was strictly limited to augmenting and adjusting the original Russian voice overs. It was used as a tool to support consistency in localization—not to replace or stand in for real voice talent.
We understand and appreciate the concerns of the community, but we want to reassure everyone that the English voice acting in Castle of Secrets is fully authentic and professionally produced.
Thank you for your continued support and for being part of the Castle of Secrets journey.
